description: Write irresistible email subject lines — enter a topic, pick a tone, and get 10 lines using curiosity, urgency, and social-proof hooks.

faqs.a: Curious, urgent, friendly, professional, and funny — each tone uses its own psychological hook templates.
Curiosity gaps, numbers, questions, urgency, social proof, personalization, and humor.
Click any subject line or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a subject line?

howto: Press Generate, then click any line to copy it.
title: Email Subject Line Generator
